title: fix(app-shell): the fallback email-template form stops offering the retired category and isSystem keys
body:
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22876

The objectui half of the `email_template.category` / `email_template.isSystem` retirement (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove). This PR leaves that card open: the spec half is the objectstack PR on branch `claude/issue-22876-dead-key-retirement-batch`, which lands after this one and after a `.objectui-sha` bump past this merge.

## What changed

One file, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/default-schemas.ts`, plus a `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`:

- **`email_template` entry:** the `category` enum input and the `isSystem` checkbox are removed. `@objectstack/spec` retires both keys with `retiredKey()` tombstones, so a form that still offered them could write a key the server refuses. A comment in place says why.
- **Same-file rider, same class (declared in the claim):** the `skill` entry's `triggerPhrases` input is removed. The spec retired that key in 17 and its parse already refuses it.
- **The file header is corrected.** It said the fallback schemas are used "for every type today", because the framework did not serve schemas. The framework now derives a `schema` for each type on `/meta/types` (with a hand-crafted fallback for a type that does not derive), and `ResourceEditPage` reads `entry.schema` first and `defaultSchema` second. The header now says the fallback is read only when the server serves no schema for the type, and that an entry must not offer a retired key.

Nothing is added to or removed from the package entry.

## Why this is hygiene, not a save fix (measured)

- Against a current server, Studio renders the served schema and the served `email-template.form.ts`, not this file. Booted on the objectstack branch (showcase, `--fresh`): `GET /api/v1/meta/types` serves the `email_template` schema without `category` or `isSystem`, and its form fields are `name`, `label`, `locale`, `description`, `subject`, `bodyHtml`, `bodyText`, `variables`, `fromOverride`, `replyTo`, `active`.
- Removing the two fields is harmless against v17 and v18 servers: both keys are optional there, and `category` has a default.

## Evidence (head `5f409db9`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` from the repo root: 476 files passed, 5401 tests passed, 1 skipped, exit 0. Scope: every importer of `default-schemas.ts` lives in `metadata-admin/` (`index.ts`, `register-builtins.ts` and three tests). Run under the shared verify lock on a shared box.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 30 of 30 tasks passed, including `app-shell:type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. It found 1 changed source file of 1 released package, declared by 1 changeset.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the changed file: exit 0.

## Landing order (triage ruling on the card, kept)

1. This PR: safe to land at any time.
2. A separate `.objectui-sha` bump card in objectstack, to a commit at or past this merge. It queues behind objectstack-ai/objectstack#22874, which holds that path today.
3. The objectstack retirement PR, parked in draft until the pin carries this change.
